bun-runtime.description: The Bun TypeScript runtime slot (Go): installs a pinned, signature-checked Bun and runs TypeScript and JavaScript extensions on it instead of Node. Copied from PiG Standard.

patches.why: the lock lives in PiG's core, which is a separate checkout here: PIG_SOURCE_ROOT, the PiG source every Piglet build uses

aot-runtime.description: The aot TypeScript runtime slot (Go): compiles a session's TypeScript extensions into one executable in the background and runs it from the next start. Copied from PiG's piglets/aot.

bench-ext10.description: The ten bench-ext extensions of the overhead bench as Go factories (ports of bench/evals/fixtures/extensions/bench-ext-NN.ts), fused into one Piglet Binary: no subprocess, no IPC. Copied from PiG's ext-matrix branch.
